title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: admin-approved branded footer on the Chat screen
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly makes a publicly hosted HTTPS logo mandatory, although Microsoft also permits uploading the default-theme logo. It also implies a separate hosting cost for the Office 365 CDN, which Microsoft says is included in the SharePoint Online subscription. The roadmap facts, default state and main configuration steps are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no automation for enabling the branded footer or setting its label.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 organization custom themes Copilot Chat branded footer PowerShell Microsoft Graph API logo automation; Copilot Chat branded footer API switch dark. Read the theme page and Graph organizationalBranding reference; no footer-setting operation found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no automation for setting the Microsoft 365 default-theme logo used by this footer.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 theme PowerShell logo Set theme; Microsoft Graph organizationalBranding resource sign-in branding Microsoft 365 custom theme logo. Read theme Logos section and Graph reference; results concern SharePoint site themes, AD FS or Entra sign-in branding.

claims.claim: At the time of writing Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell, Graph or other API for Microsoft 365 organisation themes, so the two controls are described as portal-only.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 organization custom themes Copilot Chat branded footer PowerShell Microsoft Graph API logo automation; Microsoft 365 theme PowerShell logo Set theme. Read the theme page and Graph organizationalBranding reference; no matching theme API documented.
claims.fix: Replace 'so both controls are portal-only' with 'so no automation is documented for either control'. A documentation search establishes what is documented, not that other implementations are impossible.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The logo must be an anonymously accessible HTTPS image URL.
claims.quote: Add an HTTPS image url that allows anonymous access and doesn't require authentication. For default theme, you also have an option to upload a logo image that is less than 10kb.
claims.fix: Replace the mandatory-URL statement with 'If you configure the logo by URL, it must use HTTPS and allow anonymous access without authentication. For the default theme, Microsoft also permits uploading a logo image smaller than 10kb.' Change the checklist to 'If the logo is configured by URL, confirm it uses HTTPS and allows anonymous access, and that you are happy for that hosted image to be publicly retrievable.'

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The theme page lists no licence specific to the footer.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The theme page publishes no meter, price or credit rate for the footer.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer licensing price meter dark alternate logo platform group targeting tenant switch. Read the complete theme page, including Copilot Chat and Logos sections; it contains no footer price, credit rate or meter.

claims.claim: The theme page suggests Azure Blob Storage or Office 365 Content Delivery Network as hosting locations for logo URLs.
claims.quote: Follow these steps for uploading logos to Azure Blob Storage or the Office 365 Content Delivery Network with SharePoint Online.

claims.claim: Using Azure Blob Storage to host the logo can incur storage and access costs.
claims.quote: This article helps you estimate the cost to store, upload, download, and work with data in Azure Blob Storage.
claims.fix: Narrow the Azure part of the hosting sentence to 'Hosting a logo in Azure Blob Storage can incur storage and access costs' and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/storage/blobs/blob-storage-estimate-costs. Do not add the illustrative prices from that article.

claims.claim: Using Office 365 Content Delivery Network for the logo adds a hosting cost borne by the organisation.
claims.quote: The Office 365 CDN service is included as part of your SharePoint Online subscription.
claims.fix: Remove 'or Office 365 Content Delivery Network' from the claim that hosting is an additional cost. If retaining a statement about its cost, use 'The Office 365 CDN service is included as part of your SharePoint Online subscription' and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/enterprise/use-microsoft-365-cdn-with-spo.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn says Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat are now named Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now named Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now named Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The theme page does not say whether the footer selects the alternate dark-theme logo.

claims.claim: The theme page does not describe the footer platform by platform.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer licensing price meter dark alternate logo platform group targeting tenant switch. Read the complete theme page; its footer section gives no separate Mac, mobile, desktop or web behaviour.

claims.claim: The alternate theme logo is intended to be optimised for Microsoft 365 dark themes.
claims.quote: Your alternate logo should be optimized for use in Microsoft 365 dark themes.

claims.claim: No separate tenant footer switch beyond the Copilot Chat toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat branded footer API switch dark; Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer licensing price meter dark alternate logo platform group targeting tenant switch. Read theme page and Copilot admin-center search excerpts; no separate footer switch found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph organizationalBranding documents Microsoft Entra sign-in branding rather than this Microsoft 365 theme footer.
claims.quote: Organizations can customize their Microsoft Entra sign-in pages which appear when users sign in to their organization's tenant-specific apps, or when Microsoft Entra ID identifies the user's tenant from their username.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/organizationalbranding?view=graph-rest-1.0 for the distinction between Graph sign-in branding and the theme footer.

claims.claim: The footer reads a logo but reads no user or tenant data.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer logo data access permissions sign-in autonomous actions security change; Copilot footer data sign in branding. Read theme page and Copilot privacy/security search excerpts; none specifies the footer's complete data reads.
claims.fix: Replace 'The footer reads a logo, not user or tenant data' with 'The footer displays the logo configured on the default theme's Logos page'.

claims.claim: The branded footer does not change who can sign in.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer logo data access permissions sign-in autonomous actions security change; Copilot footer data sign in branding. Read theme page, Copilot requirements and security excerpts; no passage states this footer-specific sign-in effect.
claims.fix: Remove 'it does not change who can sign in' from the sentence. Retain the advice to treat the footer as a visual cue.

claims.claim: The branded footer does not change what Copilot can reach.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer logo data access permissions sign-in autonomous actions security change. Read theme page and Copilot privacy/security excerpts; general permission boundaries are stated, but no passage states the footer's effect on data reach.
claims.fix: Remove 'or what Copilot can reach' from the sentence. Keep 'The branded footer is a logo and label' and the advice not to treat it as proof that a response is safe.

claims.claim: The footer takes no action.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer logo data access permissions sign-in autonomous actions security change. Read theme page and Copilot privacy/security excerpts; no passage specifies that the footer takes no action.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the footer displays an image and a label and takes no action' with 'Microsoft describes the footer as displaying the organisation's logo and an optional label'.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisite; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft instructs administrators to confirm the default-theme logo is configured before enabling the footer.
claims.quote: Select your Default Theme. ... On the Logos page, confirm that your organization's logo is configured. ... Open the Copilot Chat page. ... Select Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area.

claims.claim: The cost rationale says admin time is the only cost shown, while the body also identifies logo-hosting costs.
claims.quote: The only cost the sources show is admin time to configure the default theme ... Logo hosting is your own cost if you use an Azure Blob Storage or Office 365 Content Delivery Network location
claims.fix: Replace the cost rationale with 'Low. Admin time is needed to configure the default theme; optional Azure Blob Storage logo hosting can also incur costs. The theme page names no licence or meter for the footer.' Apply the separate hosting correction so the body does not imply an additional Office 365 CDN service charge.
